responsibility: This installed runtime header exposes the C6X intrinsic API to user code by defining C6X vector typedefs and a set of always-inline wrappers around __builtin_c6x_* operations. It is the source-language interface for target-specific DSP and SIMD instructions such as packed add/subtract, saturating arithmetic, fractional multiply, extract/clear, average, shifts, and related operations, translating C expressions into the backend builtins implemented by the C6X port.
